units: Source units; z=0 is every floor top (except pits); u runs along each bay's width, v into the bay

start.note: info_player_start is inside the arrival car at the bottom of its shaft; the car rises and opens (Valve's arrival logic)

tb_nop_wall_back.note: black metal next to the white back panel

tb_nop_floor.note: black metal floor behind the white floor panel

tb_pair_a.note: left wall (u=-288) at v=256, z=64 (bottom on the floor: walk into it), faces +u

go.name: tb_go_portals
go.expect: both wall portals open: walking into tb_pair_a comes out of tb_pair_b (and back), 2*hw = 576 u apart

tb_fling_ledge.note: standing surface z=640, 160 deep; tb_spot_fling_high is on it

tb_spot_fling_high.note: top of the ledge, 640 u above the floor panel

go.name: tb_go_fling
go.expect: floor portal on tb_panel_floor_fling and wall portal on tb_panel_wall_fling open; dropping from tb_spot_fling_high (640 u up, ~877 u/s) flings out of the wall portal across the bay

arrival_elevator.note: Valve's arrival logic instance; the car is arrival-elevator-elevator_1

@entry_door.note: elevator door in the hall wall (opened by the arrival logic, closed by the departure logic)

tb_entry_hall_trigger.note: in the hall, 208..272 u from the arrival doorway: opens @entry_door for a player coming from the hall

go.name: tb_go_arrival
go.expect: arrival car door opens (open relay), signs on

tb_panel_wall_mc.note: big wall for the G-portal / region portal

go.name: tb_go_mc
go.expect: extra lamp tb_mc_lamp lights the bay (nothing region related moves: portals are player placed)

tb_dark_wall.note: dark bay back wall; no lights at all until tb_go_dark

go.name: tb_go_dark
go.expect: a weak lamp at the far end (v=400 z=240) comes on; before, the bay is lit only by hall light spilling in

tb_bright_wall.note: bright bay: white walls, three strong ceiling lights

go.name: tb_go_bright
go.expect: a floor-level extra lamp lights the bay even brighter

go.name: tb_go_lift
go.expect: platform top goes z 16 -> 208 (192 u) at 64 u/s (3 s); ceiling is 384

go.name: tb_go_doorh
go.expect: sliding slab moves +u by 128 u (2 s), opening the 128 x 128 doorway in the partition at v=256..288

go.name: tb_go_mlinear
go.expect: 128 x 128 platform slides 192 u deeper into the bay (3 s)

departure_elevator.note: Valve's departure logic instance; the car is departure-elevator-elevator_1

@exit_door.note: elevator door in the hall wall (opened by the arrival logic, closed by the departure logic)

go.name: tb_go_departure
go.expect: departure car door closes, then the car rises up the 4500 u shaft

reset.name: tb_reset_departure
reset.expect: car stopped and back at the floor with its door open

go.name: tb_go_train
go.expect: train (initial speed 0, max speed 100) rides p1 (v=96) -> p2 (v=288, pauses 2 s) -> p3 (v=480, ends), 100 u/s

reset.name: tb_reset_train
reset.expect: train stopped and teleported back to p1

go.name: tb_go_rotate
go.expect: 192 x 192 disc spins at 20 deg/s about z (accelerates over ~2 s)

reset.name: tb_reset_rotate
reset.expect: disc stops (stays at whatever angle it reached)

tb_tilt.tilt: 20 deg about the u axis at v=128, 10 deg/s
tb_tilt.note: (bridge #39) passable root (it only turns) carrying tb_tilt_panel, a 192 x 192 x 16 solid func_brush (top z 16); the lattice plates are gone

tb_tilt_panel.note: (bridge #39) the solid walking surface, parented to tb_tilt

tb_ramp_arm.note: (bridge #39) Valve's arm64x64_interior_rusty (solid 6), animated by SetAnimation rampa_stair01_up / _down

tb_ramp.tilt: 15 deg and about +23 u along +v, +5 u up over 1.7 s (rampa_stair01_up)
tb_ramp.note: (bridge #39) 96 x 96 x 8 solid panel (rest top z 16) attached to the arm's panel_attach: Valve's moving-panel pattern, no Source pusher

go.name: tb_go_tilt
go.expect: 192 x 192 panel (tb_tilt_panel) tilts 20 degrees about its v=128 edge in 2 s; at the back of the bay the arm panel tb_ramp slides 23 u, rises 5 u and tips 15 degrees in 1.7 s

tb_doorpanel_model.note: arm_64x64_justtop (solid 6) x4 parented to the nodraw door cube, top flush with the floor (the first is this one)

go.name: tb_go_doorpanel
go.expect: nodraw func_door cube (z -128..0) rises 128 u at 48 u/s carrying four parented arm_64x64_justtop plates; the walkable top goes z 0 -> 128

tb_arm.note: stairs.vmf: arm_8panel ramp, 4 func_brush steps on it; inner names tb_arm-*

go.name: tb_go_arm
go.expect: tb_arm-model_arms animates (SetPlaybackRate/animation): the 8-panel arm unfolds into a stair ramp along +v

tb_cube.note: starts 224 u up and falls; ForceSpawn of tb_cube_template drops another

tb_btn_floor.note: pressed by the cube or a player; lights tb_btn_lamp

go.name: tb_go_cubes
go.expect: a new cube appears at tb_cube's start spot and falls 224 u to the floor; both buttons are pressed, their lamps come on

reset.name: tb_reset_cubes
reset.expect: every cube dissolves, floor button released

tb_laser_emitter.beam: +u across the bay at z=64, v=256

tb_laser_catcher.note: receives the emitter's beam; lights tb_laser_lamp

tb_laser_relay.note: on the back wall; powered by a redirected beam

tb_laser_cube.note: reflective cube (CubeType 1): pick up and put in the beam

go.name: tb_go_laser
go.expect: beam from tb_laser_emitter (left wall) crosses 576 u to tb_laser_catcher; the catcher powers and tb_laser_lamp lights

reset.name: tb_reset_laser
reset.expect: beam off, catcher unpowered, lamp off

tb_bridge.note: left wall, projects +u across a 128 u wide, 192 deep pit

tb_bridge_pit.note: bottom of the pit the bridge spans

go.name: tb_go_bridge
go.expect: a light bridge crosses the pit (v 192..320, 192 deep) along the u axis at z=40 from the left wall to the right wall

tb_funnel.note: floor emitter, beam up to the ceiling at z=384

go.name: tb_go_funnel
go.expect: excursion funnel rises from the floor at u=0, v=256 to the ceiling; entering it lifts a player or cube at 250 u/s

tb_faith.note: (bridge #32) speed 350 and no threshold check: a standing player is launched along a 75 u high arc; Valve's maps use 600 and useThresholdCheck 1

tb_faith_target.note: landing spot, 384 u from the plate along +v

go.name: tb_go_faith
go.expect: plate arm animates and the catapult trigger is armed: stepping on the plate launches a player or cube at 350 u/s to tb_faith_target (an arc about 75 u high)

tb_fizzler.note: 128 x 128 emancipation grid in the partition doorway at v=272

tb_fizz_cube.note: carry it into the grid to see it dissolve

go.name: tb_go_fizzler
go.expect: grid turns OFF (it starts on): the doorway at v=272 can be crossed by a cube or a portal

reset.name: tb_reset_fizzler
reset.expect: grid on again: anything crossing it is fizzled

tb_turret.note: faces the bay opening, range 1024, starts inactive

go.name: tb_go_turret
go.expect: turret wakes and tracks/fires at anything in its 1024 u range along its facing (toward the hall)

tb_goo_hurt.note: kills on contact; goo surface z=-32, pit v 160..400 across the whole bay width

go.name: tb_go_goo
go.expect: goo stops hurting (go = harmless), reset = deadly again; the pit is 240 u deep in v, 96 u deep

tb_door.note: test chamber door in the partition, doorway 128 x 128

go.name: tb_go_doors
go.expect: door animates open (about 1.5 s), the doorway at v=272 is passable

tb_gel.note: blue (bounce) gel straight down onto the floor at v=256

go.name: tb_go_gel
go.expect: gel falls from the ceiling at u=0 v=256 (8 blobs/s, 60 u/s) and coats the floor
